kitDescription: Rapunzel is a Pilgrim rocket-launcher Burst-I supporter whose entire kit is team sustain. Every full-charge shot she fires heals the 3 allies with the lowest HP percentage for a fraction of her own max HP. Her Skill 2 repeatedly grants the 2 highest-ATK allies a max-HP increase and an incoming-healing increase for 15 seconds at a time. Her burst heals the whole team for a large share of her max HP, revives one fallen ally at 81.67% HP, and stuns all enemies for 1 second whenever an ally drops below 30% HP. She contributes no damage buffs, debuffs, or weapon modifiers of any kind — her value is keeping the team alive and enabling allies whose kits react to being healed.

redAssertions: S5 skill2 'targets.size === 2' (union over all applications): observed union {helm,liter,rapunzel} = 3 across 11 firings — blind-test miscalibration; byFinalAtk:true (the prose's literal 'highest FINAL ATK') legitimately re-ranks the #2 slot as live ATK shifts, while EVERY application targets exactly 2 (per-frame counts === [2]). Classified RECON_ERROR; adapted test asserts per-frame === 2 and is green, as is the driver's own spec.

S5 FB_TRIGGER counterfactual 'CROWN_HEALS_FB <= FB + 2': observed 8 heals vs 5 fullBurstStart events (8 <= 7 fails by one) — blind-test bound miscalibration; the discrimination signal (fullBurstEnter << shotFired cadence) is intact via the unchanged '< CROWN_HEALS/3' (8 < ~33). Classified RECON_ERROR; adapted bound <= FB*2 absorbs it without touching the signal. Adapted suite vs driver override: 10 passed / 4 skipped (the 4 skips are the declared GAP lines) — GREEN.

Driver spec pins per-frame target count === 2, flat value === 8.19% × each target's own maxHp, expiresFrame − applyFrame === 900, and byte-identical totals on removal.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs. All six kit lines are accounted for: three FAITHFUL (S1 per-full-charge heal event, S2 targetMaxHpPct on the 2 highest-final-ATK allies, burst heal keyed to her own burstCast) and three DOCUMENTED_GAPs (incoming-healing, resurrect, HP-gated stun — each verbatim in unmodeled with ⚑, recipe, and tier, and each gated on a primitive v1 genuinely lacks: no HP pool, no incoming-healing StatKey, no death/revive or enemy-action model). The two REDs in the raw S5 run are blind-test calibration errors, not driver faults: the S2 union-count assertion ignores that the prose's literal 'highest FINAL ATK' legitimately re-ranks the #2 slot between applications (per-application count is exactly 2 — proven by per-frame counts and by the driver's own spec), and the FB+2 counterfactual bound was mis-set by one while its actual discrimination signal (fullBurstEnter << per-shot cadence) held and holds. Both adapted assertions pass; the adapted blind suite is GREEN against the shipped override, and the blind override (S6) is functionally identical to the driver's except the S2 trigger, where the driver's interval:15 is the more faithful reading under the engine's own internal-cooldown precedent — a documented, inert, defensible choice. Discrimination is strong: damage-neutrality is proven byte-identical solo and in a bare team (group N); R1–R4 pin per-shot cadence, channel attribution, and the burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter keying at frame level in a two-B1 fixture; the S2 tests pin count, basis (target's own HP), duration, and inertness-by-removal. Ranked residuals the owner should spot-check (all same-model convergence, none blocking): (1) the alliesLowestHp leftmost-3 stand-in is a shared assumption across all agents — it is inert today (heals carry no amount) but becomes load-bearing the moment an HP pool or heal magnitudes land; (2) the shotFired≈full-charge identity rests on the helm/liberalio RL precedent, unverified against a rapunzel-focus video — the driver's charged-flag assert makes the sim-side read honest but the game-side premise is a ⚑ worth one popup-cadence read; (3) the S2 interval first-fire phase (t=15) is convention, per the standing interval-trigger ⚑. For GO, nothing must change.
